title: Daugherty Wetland Restoration Project Clark County, Illinois
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.FARM PRODUCTION AND CONSERVATION BUSINESS CENTER.FPAC BUS CNTR-ACQ DIV
description_text: This work is for the United States Department of Agriculture - Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) for the State of Illinois. This project involves excavation of pools, tile exploration, and habitat mounds. The work consists of the mobilization and demobilization of the contractor's forces and equipment necessary for performing the work required under the contract. Excavation required by the drawings and specifications and disposal of the excavated materials; Furnishing and placing seed in designated areas as specified. See Attachments for further details. SITE VISIT. Interested vendors can review the work site by attending the Site Visit on May 5, 2026, at 10:00am CT. Site Visit Location: USDA/NRCS Service Center, 1001 N. York Street, Martinsville IL 62442 Review of the work site is not mandatory, but highly recommended. Site Visit POC: Matt Dassenbrock at matt.dassenbrock@usda.gov, (217)208-4020. Any questions must be submitted in writing to Bobby Copenny II, Contract Specialist, at bobby.copenny@usda.gov no later than May 12, 2026, 2:00pm CT
